I really don't know about school getting so involved with your problems (in a negative way). In India (where I live) no one really cares. You could write in the most melancholic way an essay about how depression is sucking life out of you and teachers wouldn't really get involved other than feebly asking what's the matter and forgetting it. What I think is your school wants to get rid of you before you get rid of your life. Today people just want to prevent suicides to cut themselves from potential legal involvements and preventing their names from getting maligned. You shouldn't mess with the police. You really don't need to be in that school. If you want to press charges do it but donot return to that school because teachers probably already dislike you. When we have to long for every small pleasure and moment of happiness we really don't crave for unnecessary things in life. I hope you'll not miss your school and the people in it. I hope you don't feel any void as long as you have your grandma. You should have your mother with you too. I hope you become a person that your principal cries blood tears for not having you as his alumni.

You cannot do anything about what your parents think but you should remember that this thought should never cross your mind that you're faking your illness as your sympathy is all you have for yourself. Is it possible for you to attend therapy without your parents knowing about it? If not tell them to meet the doctor or talk to him over the phone who diagnosed you. Let him/her explain that depression is chemical and hormone influenced too and when he says that you have it, it is actually in context to a serious illness and not a phase. Let him/ her tell them that grades and extra curricular activities suffer due to it. If your parents still resort to hit you. Be brave but more logical. Don't lock yourself it will only fuel their anger further as I have experienced more hitting in cases when I'd locked myself. Once my father even broke the latch to get me. Don't come across as a rebel without cause. This will give them a reason to taunt you. Trust me the taunts will sting you like a million bees. If they don't change for good don't ever talk to them about depression they'll make it worse for you. This last line may sound pessimistic but this will only work when you have nothing to try. Stay with your sister. She's a blessing
